Subject: Quick credits for PLG signup (Conversant)

Hi Ben —

We just signed up a couple hours ago (email: samir@nebulalabs.ai) to try Redwood for a short proof-of-concept. Our app is Conversant, a customer-support assistant that will do a few hundred calls per day in the trial and we need some headroom to run a 2-week experiment.

Is there a way to get a modest trial credit top-up to validate latency/throughput? I filled the self-serve form but the onboarding quota cut us off quickly. Attaching an estimated usage spreadsheet and a screenshot of the signup chat.

What we plan to evaluate:
- 500 sessions/day for 14 days, average 300 tokens/request, 2 requests/session (warm cache expected)
- Priority is: <1s generation latency and stable throughput during a simulated spike

Attached: conversant_usage_estimate.xlsx (spreadsheet) and signup-chat-screenshot.png

Happy to hop on a short call if helpful.

Thanks,
Samir Rao
Co-founder, Nebula Labs
samir@nebulalabs.ai

Hi Samir —

Thanks for the details and the spreadsheet, that helps. I'm looping in Laura from our PLG ops to triage the request and Dev from infra to sanity-check the latency requirements. A few quick questions to help us size the credit:

- Are the 500 sessions/day steady or bursty? If bursty, when do you expect the spikes and for how long?
- Do you have any PII in prompts that would require additional controls (we can route to Dedicated/private if needed)?
- Ideal timeline: do you need credits today or will tomorrow be OK?

Next steps: Laura will confirm an approval and top-up amount; if approved we'll tag your account with trial_credit:NebulaPilot and send activation instructions + a calendar link for a 30-min SRE/SE handoff.
